name: Minecraft Skin Maker
short_description: Turn an image or description into a Minecraft skin.
description: Attach a character image, describe an idea, or revise an existing skin. Minecraft Skin Maker creates a 64×64 skin PNG, an editable design, previews rendered from the exported texture, and a Bedrock skin pack. It handles technical choices automatically and compares the output with your reference. Requires an agent with image inspection, file access and Python execution. Java and Windows/mobile Bedrock import instructions are included.
starter_prompts: Turn this character image into a Minecraft skin.
Make a Minecraft skin of a forest explorer with a red scarf.
Change this skin’s hoodie to green and keep its other details.
release_notes: Adds portable, Codex, Claude Code and Cursor plugin manifests; a Claude Code marketplace; submission materials; and reproducible release packages. The skin-generation helpers are unchanged.
